title: The Obliterator Machine
description: A Remade of THE OBLITERATOR 9000 from Regretevator
body:
so.. i remade the obliterator 9000 in minecraft (with MCreator), orignally from regretevator.


<details>
<summary>What Things Added</summary>

<details>
<summary>Trash Can</summary>

- Eating a Trash Can will put you into Trash Can Dimension.
- Right-Clicking with a Player will send target entity to Trash Can Dimension. or else, despawn mob.

</details>

<details>
<summary>The Obliterator 9000</summary>

- Needs 1 XP Level to Remove Item.
  - Sound ID: obliterator.result.success
- If you didnt meet the condition, Minecraft will play these sound variant:
  - Background Error
  - Foreground Error
  - Bareground Error (???)
    - Sound ID: obliterator.result.failed

</details>



</details>
